newsitem.title: USA: N.J. to file anti-competitive suit against Trump.
newsitem.headline: N.J. to file anti-competitive suit against Trump.

text.p: New Jersey's Casino Reinvestment Development Authority will file a lawsuit on Monday alleging anti-competitive behavior by Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc., an agency source said.
The source said the agency would not comment further until the complaint was filed later today.

Trump Hotels sued the casino authority last month, alleging that the agency's part in financing a $330 million tunnel in Atlantic City violates a state constitutional amendment that permits casinos in New Jersey.
Authority officials said last month they were considering a range of options to counter the lawsuit, including the anti-competitiveness complaint.

The tunnel project is being financed in part with casino agency bonds. Donald Trump has opposed the project, arguing that it gives rival casino developers, most notably Steve Wynn, unfair competitive advantages. The tunnel would provide access to Wynn's proposed Mirage Resorts Inc hotel in the marina district.
Trump Hotels officials were not immediately available for comment.
